title: Auto Loans: Due Day Change Service Action
content:
This page documents the Piedmont Crescent Bank service action that moves the monthly due day of an Auto Loans account to the day the borrower has chosen.

## What the action does

A single call records the new day of the month on which the loan's installments fall due, records the next installment due date on that new day, and records today as the date of the loan's latest due date change. The maturity date and the balances are left untouched and no fee is booked. Afterwards the borrower sees the new due day and next due date on the loan.

## How it is reached

`change_due_day_df9bec35` is an agent tool that stays hidden until the agent unlocks it; after unlocking, the agent calls it itself.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it holds | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | the reference number of the loan whose due day moves, as it appears when the borrower's auto loans are looked up | identifier |
| `new_due_day` | the day of the month on which installments will fall due | whole number from 1 to 28, a calendar day of the month |
| `next_payment_due_date` | the next installment due date, falling on the new due day | YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2031-03-28 |

## Receipt

The call has succeeded when the receipt shows status "due_day_changed". The receipt also lists `auto_loan_id`, `payment_due_day` (the new day, 1 to 28), `next_payment_due_date` and `last_due_date_change_date`, which is today's date.

## Illustration (hypothetical call)

A call naming a loan, the new day 18 and a next installment date of 2031-05-18 returns status "due_day_changed", a recorded due day of 18, the next due date 2031-05-18, and today's date as the date of the change.
